answer: Treat identity as a graph vertex, not an account. Every agent emits a signed pulse every 10 minutes, and two agents may form a trust edge only by exchanging 200 unbroken pulses over 14 days from distinct network prefixes. Fresh nodes dock at a jetty: a probation zone where degree is capped at 2 and scores don't count. To spawn 10,000 clones, an attacker needs 10,000 honest partners and 140 days of clean pulses each; one dropped pulse resets the clock. Sybil farming becomes an endless 28-year jetty queue: like mooring a fleet of ghost ships one rowboat at a time.
